method: NEO Estates 100-point site-fit matrix using currently public listing data; unknown diligence items scored conservatively and must be verified before LOI.

deals.financing_note: Listing terms include Owner Will Carry, plus cash/conventional/FHA/VA.
deals.public_facts: 8 beds, 4 baths, 3,959 sq ft, 8,672 sq ft lot, built 1964, public water/sewer.
deals.primary_upside: Low acquisition basis per square foot, 8-bedroom layout, large common area, seller-finance signal.
deals.primary_risk: Small residential lot and unknown use/occupancy, flood, insurance, electrical and renovation requirements.
deals.recommended_next_action: Request seller-finance terms, seller disclosure, survey, insurance history, electrical service details, and confirm occupancy/use constraints.

deals.public_facts: 7,500 SF, 0.37 acres, 8.50% in-place cap rate, 18 ft clear height, 2 grade-level doors, fenced yard, no zoning listed.
deals.primary_upside: Existing cash-flow signal, industrial use, loading, separation potential, access to I-10.
deals.primary_risk: Power capacity/tariff, tenant lease terms, roof/HVAC/environmental/insurance and limited expansion acreage require diligence.
deals.recommended_next_action: Request rent roll, lease, T-12, utility bills, electrical one-line/service capacity, environmental history and property-condition report.

deals.public_facts: 10 acres, cleared/fenced, gated entrance, electrical poles installed, few restrictions reported, access to Hwy 90.
deals.primary_upside: Clean-slate compound/ecovillage potential and expansion room.
deals.primary_risk: No building income, unknown water/septic/flood/drainage/soil/entitlement costs, full development capex required.
deals.recommended_next_action: Obtain restrictions, survey, floodplain, soil/drainage, utility availability/cost, access, septic/well feasibility and preliminary site plan.

deals.public_facts: 10 unrestricted acres, 4 beds, 3 baths, 3,100 sq ft home built 2022, office, pool, oversized garage, barn, storage shed, pond, automation/security.
deals.primary_upside: Existing flagship house plus unrestricted acreage and outbuildings reduce time-to-activation.
deals.primary_risk: Higher acquisition basis; unknown utilities, insurance, flood, carrying cost and revenue plan.
deals.recommended_next_action: Request survey, restrictions/title, utility/electrical details, insurance/flood history, tax data and seller financing/terms.

deals.public_facts: 5 beds, 7 baths, 6,864 sq ft, 0.41 acres, built 1994, mother-in-law suite with separate exterior entrance, large garage capacity, cul-de-sac.
deals.primary_upside: Excellent creator-house scale, multigenerational layout, separate-entry suite, strong garage/space flexibility.
deals.primary_risk: Higher carrying cost and residential-site limits on compute/expansion.
deals.recommended_next_action: Request disclosures, floor plan, electrical service, HOA/deed restrictions, insurance/flood history and seller flexibility.
